```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(gtsummary)
library(chisq.posthoc.test)
library(english)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(stringr)
library(ggthemes)
library(gtExtras)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(gt)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "90%")

# ============================================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================================
data <- read_excel("~/Downloads/Tox Book.v2 (1).xlsx", sheet = "INTOXICATE")
data <- data %>% mutate(row_id = row_number())

valid_categories <- c("Combination", "Analgesic", "Antidepressants",
                      "Street Drugs", "CO, As, CN", "Sedatives", "Alcohol", "Unknown")

clean_data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gender), !is.na(`Exposure Category`)) %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = trimws(Gender),
    `Exposure Category` = trimws(`Exposure Category`),
    `INTOXICATE SCORE` = as.numeric(`INTOXICATE SCORE`),
    `Dichotomous Outcome` = case_when(tolower(`Actual Disposition`) == "icu" ~ 1L, TRUE ~ 0L),
    Age = as.numeric(Age)
  ) %>%
  filter(Gender %in% c("M", "F"), `Exposure Category` %in% valid_categories,
         !is.na(Age), Age >= 12) %>%
  mutate(dataset = ifelse(row_id <= 117, "original", "accrued"))

category_counts <- clean_data %>% count(`Exposure Category`) %>% arrange(desc(n))
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(`Exposure Category` = factor(`Exposure Category`, levels = category_counts$`Exposure Category`))

n_total <- nrow(clean_data)
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))

wilson_ci <- function(x, n) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(0, 0, 0))
  z <- 1.96; p <- x / n
  denom <- 1 + z^2/n
  center <- (p + z^2/(2*n)) / denom
  spread <- z * sqrt((p*(1-p) + z^2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
  c(p, max(0, center - spread), min(1, center + spread))
}

model_data <- clean_data %>% filter(!is.na(`INTOXICATE SCORE`))
model_original <- model_data %>% filter(dataset == "original")

# gtsummary helper (from Mike's code)
add_row_vs_rest_chisq <- function(tbl, data, row, col, p_adj = "fdr") {
  row_var <- rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(row))
  col_var <- rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(col))
  df <- data %>% dplyr::select({{ row }}, {{ col }})
  lvls <- unique(df[[row_var]])
  results <- lapply(lvls, function(lvl) {
    df2 <- df %>% mutate(row_bin = ifelse(.data[[row_var]] == lvl, lvl, "All Others"))
    tab <- table(df2$row_bin, df2[[col_var]])
    suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)$p.value)
  })
  out <- tibble::tibble(row_type = "level", row_var_name = row_var, level = lvls,
    p_row = unlist(results), p_row_adj = p.adjust(unlist(results), method = p_adj))
  tbl %>%
    gtsummary::modify_table_body(~ dplyr::left_join(.x, out,
      by = c("row_type"="row_type","variable"="row_var_name","label"="level"))) %>%
    gtsummary::modify_header(p_row ~ "**Row vs Rest p**", p_row_adj ~ "**Row vs Rest p (adj)**") %>%
    modify_table_styling(columns = c("p_row_adj","p_row"), rows = p_row_adj < 0.05, text_format = "bold") %>%
    modify_fmt_fun(
      p_row ~ function(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(round(x, 3), nsmall = 3)),
      p_row_adj ~ function(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(round(x, 3), nsmall = 3)))
}
```

# Key Results for Abstract {-}

```{r key_results, results='asis'}
# ============================================================================
# 1. DEMOGRAPHICS
# ============================================================================
cat("## 1. Demographics\n\n")
for (ds in list(list("Original external validation set", model_original),
                list("Larger data set", model_data))) {
  d <- ds[[2]]; label <- ds[[1]]; n <- nrow(d)
  f <- d %>% filter(Gender == "F"); m <- d %>% filter(Gender == "M")
  cat(sprintf("**%s (n=%d):** %d females (%d%%), median age %.0f [IQR %.0f--%.0f]; %d males (%d%%), median age %.0f [IQR %.0f--%.0f]\n\n",
    label, n,
    nrow(f), round(100*nrow(f)/n), median(f$Age), quantile(f$Age,.25), quantile(f$Age,.75),
    nrow(m), round(100*nrow(m)/n), median(m$Age), quantile(m$Age,.25), quantile(m$Age,.75)))
}

# ============================================================================
# 2. SEX-EXPOSURE (all valid patients)
# ============================================================================
cat("## 2. Sex-Exposure Association (N=", n_total, ")\n\n")
cont_table <- table(clean_data$`Exposure Category`, clean_data$Gender)
chi_result <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(cont_table))
cat(sprintf("**Overall chi-squared test: p = %s**\n\n", format_p(chi_result$p.value)))
for (exp_cat in c("Antidepressants", "Street Drugs", "CO, As, CN")) {
  e <- clean_data %>% filter(`Exposure Category` == exp_cat) %>% count(Gender) %>% mutate(pct = round(100*n/sum(n)))
  cat(sprintf("- %s: %d%% female, %d%% male\n", exp_cat,
    (e %>% filter(Gender=="F"))$pct, (e %>% filter(Gender=="M"))$pct))
}

# ============================================================================
# 3. MODEL PERFORMANCE
# Without sex: INTOXICATE score > 6
# With sex: (INTOXICATE score + 3 if male) > 6
# The +3 is derived from glm(ICU ~ Score + Gender): sex coefficient / score
# coefficient, scaled to the points system
# ============================================================================
cat("\n## 3. Model Performance (INTOXICATE score > 6)\n\n")

# Justification for +3
cat("**Deriving the male adjustment:**\n")
cat("glm(ICU \\~ INTOXICATE\\_SCORE + Gender) on the larger dataset yields a sex\n")
cat("coefficient of 1.29 [0.45--2.14], p=0.003. Scaling to the INTOXICATE points\n")
cat("system gives +3 points for biological males.\n\n")

print_metrics <- function(pred, actual, label) {
  tp <- sum(pred==1 & actual==1); fn <- sum(pred==0 & actual==1)
  tn <- sum(pred==0 & actual==0); fp <- sum(pred==1 & actual==0)
  s <- wilson_ci(tp, tp+fn); sp <- wilson_ci(tn, tn+fp)
  cat(sprintf("| %s | %.3f | %.3f--%.3f | %.3f | %.3f--%.3f |\n",
    label, s[1], s[2], s[3], sp[1], sp[2], sp[3]))
}

for (ds in list(list("Original external validation set", model_original),
                list("Larger data set", model_data))) {
  d <- ds[[2]]; label <- ds[[1]]
  actual <- d$`Dichotomous Outcome`
  scores <- d$`INTOXICATE SCORE`
  genders <- d$Gender

  cat(sprintf("\n**%s (n=%d):**\n\n", label, nrow(d)))
  cat("| | Sensitivity | 95% CI | Specificity | 95% CI |\n")
  cat("|---|---|---|---|---|\n")

  # Without sex
  pred_base <- ifelse(scores > 6, 1, 0)
  print_metrics(pred_base, actual, "Without sex")

  # With sex: +3 for male
  adj_scores <- ifelse(genders == "M", scores + 3, scores)
  pred_sex <- ifelse(adj_scores > 6, 1, 0)
  print_metrics(pred_sex, actual, "With sex (+3 male)")
  cat("\n")
}

# Regression details for reference
cat("\n## 4. Regression Coefficients (for reference)\n\n")
for (ds in list(list("Original", model_original), list("Combined", model_data))) {
  d <- ds[[2]]; label <- ds[[1]]
  model_glm <- glm(`Dichotomous Outcome` ~ `INTOXICATE SCORE` + Gender, data = d, family = binomial)
  ci <- confint(model_glm)
  sex_coef <- coef(summary(model_glm))["GenderM", ]
  cat(sprintf("**%s (n=%d):** Sex coefficient %.3f [%.3f--%.3f], p=%s\n\n",
    label, nrow(d), sex_coef["Estimate"], ci["GenderM",1], ci["GenderM",2],
    format_p(sex_coef["Pr(>|z|)"])))
}

cat("**Reference — INTOXICATE-US paper (adults only, n=77, score > 6):**\n")
cat("Sensitivity: 0.69 [0.41--0.89], Specificity: 0.38 [0.26--0.51]\n")
```

  tbl_cross(`Exposure Category`, Gender, percent = 'row',
   label = list(Gender ~ "Biological Sex")) %>%
  add_overall() %>% add_p() %>% italicize_levels() %>%
  add_row_vs_rest_chisq(clean_data, `Exposure Category`, Gender)
